items.title: FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
items.summary: arXiv:2611.21647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide
items.summary_zh: FieldGuide 通过构建文档集合的主题层级结构（Corpus Map），为 Agent 提供导航索引，显著降低大规模文档探索任务中的 Token 消耗与响应延迟。
items.why_zh: 属于 RAG 与 Agent 规划优化领域。可复用做法：通过预处理构建领域知识图谱或层级索引，引导 Agent 进行高效的定向检索而非全量扫描。

items.title: mdiri-ai/SoduWork
items.summary: The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.
items.summary_zh: SoduWork 是一个支持多 Agent 协作、多任务编排且可自托管的 AI 原生引擎，旨在为团队提供统一的 Agent 运行与管理基础设施。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 编排与系统架构领域。可复用做法：学习如何设计多 Agent 协作的通信协议与任务调度机制，实现复杂业务流程的自动化闭环。

items.title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
items.summary: arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extra
items.summary_zh: NEBench R1 是一个针对核工程领域的推理基准测试，不仅评估 LLM 的知识准确性，更侧重于评估模型在安全关键领域推理过程的逻辑质量。
items.why_zh: 属于垂直领域模型评估与推理能力验证。可复用做法：在构建行业模型时，通过引入过程导向的评估指标（Reasoning Quality）来提升模型在复杂逻辑任务中的可靠性。

items.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference
items.summary_zh: Energy-Based Reasoners 通过能量函数建模推理过程，在保持逻辑正确性的前提下，将推理任务的计算效率提升了 385 倍。
items.why_zh: 属于高效推理与模型优化领域。可复用做法：利用能量模型（Energy-Based Models）替代传统的自回归生成，探索降低推理延迟与计算成本的架构设计。

items.title: Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review
items.summary_zh: 哈佛大学研究发现，AI 编码 Agent 的普及将软件开发的瓶颈从代码编写转移到了代码审查环节，导致审查工作量与复杂性显著增加。
items.why_zh: 属于 AI 工程化与工作流优化领域。可复用做法：在 Agent 落地实践中，需配套构建自动化代码审查与合规性检查流程，以应对 Agent 生成代码带来的质量管控挑战。

items.title: EL4CTEO/blender-skills

items.summary_zh: blender-skills 将 Blender 5.3 的专业建模、渲染与动画工作流封装为可供 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具调用的 Agent 技能集。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 工具调用与领域知识封装。可复用做法：通过将复杂软件的 API 操作封装为标准化的 Agent Tool，实现 AI 对专业生产力软件的深度控制。

items.title: erkamyaman/rust-anything
items.summary: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
items.summary_zh: rust-anything 提供了一套增量重构工具，支持将 TypeScript、Python 等语言编写的 CLI 或 HTTP 服务逐步迁移至 Rust，并利用录制行为进行一致性校验。
items.why_zh: 系统架构迁移与测试验证。学习如何通过录制原始系统行为作为基准，在重构过程中实现自动化回归测试，降低大规模代码库迁移风险。

items.title: vercel-labs/ui
items.summary: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
items.summary_zh: vercel-labs/ui 是一套专门为 AI Agent 设计的交互行为库，旨在通过标准化的 UI 组件和交互模式，提升 Agent 与用户之间的协作效率。
items.why_zh: Agent UI/UX 设计。掌握如何将 Agent 的决策过程与状态变化映射为直观的 UI 交互，提升人机协作的透明度与可控性。

items.title: SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode
items.summary: SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning. A single agent reaches 0.585 NDCG in 3.11 seconds, and a 12-agent SID-2 Swarm scores 0.720 NDCG, above GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark. The post SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: SID-2 是一款基于强化学习训练的 Agentic Search 模型，通过 Swarm Mode 多智能体协作，在搜索任务中达到 0.720 NDCG 的性能表现。
items.why_zh: 多智能体协作与搜索优化。学习如何通过多 Agent 协同（Swarm Mode）提升复杂任务的准确率，以及如何利用 NDCG 指标评估搜索质量。

items.title: Building 3D video sets with GPT-6.2 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra is our new flagship model, delivering a step up in capability with cleaner code, better frontends and 3D models, and more efficient tool use. Recreate a room from just two video frames with GPT-6.2 Astra in Codex. See how it builds the set in Blender, changes the decor and lighting, and turns the scene into an interactive space and a virtual webcam background.
items.summary_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 演示了从少量视频帧生成 3D 场景的能力，支持在 Blender 中自动构建模型、调整光照并转化为交互式空间。
items.why_zh: 多模态生成与工具调用。学习如何构建 Agent 的多模态感知能力，并将其与 3D 建模工具链集成，实现从非结构化数据到复杂工程资产的自动化转换。

items.title: Fireside Chat With Alex Atallah, OpenRouter
items.summary: Alex Atallah, CEO and Co-Founder of OpenRouter, the model marketplace and AI gateway, explains how teams choose among models and providers: why companies tend to add model families over time, how he sorts work into low, medium, and high entropy tasks to decide when you need a frontier model, and why a different model family should check an agent's output. He also walks through OpenRouter's continuous provider benchmarking, the Fusion server tool, three kinds of routing, and whether routing belon…
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter CEO Alex Atallah 探讨了模型选型策略，提出根据任务熵值（Entropy）分配模型算力，并利用不同模型族进行交叉验证。
items.why_zh: AI 工程化选型与鲁棒性设计。学习如何根据任务复杂度动态调度模型，以及通过多模型交叉验证（Cross-checking）提升 Agent 输出的可靠性。

items.title: Closing the Loop | Introduction to LangSmith (11/12)
items.summary: In the Monitor stage, five LangSmith features worked together to surface the LangSlice agent's second bug. The confirm_order tool checks the delivery minimum against the sides and ignores the pizzas. This short lesson lays out how that chain fit together and what fixing the bug looks like. Fixing it sends us back to the Test stage. The confirmed threads in the annotation queue and the delivery complaints Insights clustered both push straight to a dataset. From there, a code evaluator that recomp…
items.summary_zh: LangSmith 演示了通过 Monitor 阶段的五个功能模块定位 Agent 逻辑漏洞，并展示了从发现 Bug 到修复并回归测试的完整闭环流程。
items.why_zh: Agent 运维与调试。掌握 Agent 开发生命周期中的监控与反馈闭环，学习如何利用工具链进行自动化错误追踪与回归测试。

items.title: External sandboxes for coding agents
items.summary: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine. I worked on this project with Prime Radiant , the AI research lab behind Superpowers and other projects . My post on the Prime Radiant blog introduces the external sandbox pattern, where code executed by the agent runs …
items.summary_zh: 通过外部沙箱环境隔离 AI Agent 执行的代码，防止本地模型因指令注入或逻辑错误对宿主机造成破坏，提升 Agent 运行安全性。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 安全架构技能点，可学习如何利用容器化或虚拟化技术构建不可信代码执行环境，实现 Agent 权限最小化控制。

items.title: [AINews] GPT-6.2 Astra, the #2 Frontier Model is better and 20%-600% cheaper, but has mixed reviews; 6.2 Sol likely main workhorse
items.summary: November 17, 2026 — GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol lower benchmark costs. Early testers disagree on what Astra is like to work with.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 模型，在降低 20%-600% 推理成本的同时提升性能，其中 Sol 模型被定位为主要生产力工具。
items.why_zh: 属于大模型选型与成本优化技能点，可学习如何评估不同规模模型在实际业务场景中的性价比及性能权衡策略。
